The Full-Powered Fire Pose!'') is the 12th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * [[Lana]] and [[Mallow]] stay back to fight the {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s while {{adv|Sun}}, {{adv|Moon}}, and [[Kiawe]] head to the [[Ruins of Life]] to protect {{p|Tapu Lele}}. * Kiawe teaches Sun how to perform the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}. * [[Gladion]] is revealed to be Kiawe's attacker and has managed to capture {{p|Tapu Lele}}. * Kiawe tries to lend his [[Z-Ring]] to Sun, but it is destroyed by Gladion's {{TP|Gladion|Type: Null}}. * [[Kahili]] appears and delivers Sun his Z-Ring that was created by [[Hala]]. * With the Z-Ring, Sun and {{adv|Dollar}} activate Inferno Overdrive. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Toucannon}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Hala]] (flashback) * [[Kahili]] * [[Gladion]] * {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Litten}} ({{adv|Dollar}};
